Personality: Lucas values ​​the family name and the tradition of the Vale Knights, and is more restrained than Lynn in dealing with things. He knew that the Corbray family needed not only a famous sword, but also land, a marriage contract, and the trust of their vassals.
Background: Lucas is a member of the Corbray family and lives in the mountain passes and lord system of the valley. His identity requires him to safeguard the interests of his family while dealing with the impact of Lynn Corbray's sharp edge on his relatives.
